page.layout: One printed page. Running head at top centre ("CAPVT XII.") with page number 179 at top right. Main text in one column, with marginal notes in the right margin beside the text (Gen.12. 7, & 13. 15, & 15. 18). main_text.l: ad Carmelum vnus.
23 Rex Dor ad Naphath-dor vnus,
rex Goim in Gilgal vnus.
24 Rex Thirsa vnus: omnes reges
triginta & vnus.
1 Hi sunt reges.) Caput hoc non longa expo-
sitione indiget: quia tantum reges enumerat quo-
rum ditionibus potiti sunt Israelitæ. Sunt autem
duo trans Iordanem, Og & Sihon, qui late do-
minabatur: in terra vero Chanaan triginta vnus.
Etsi autem prolixius narrata sunt singula quorum
ἀνακεφαλαίωσις nunc breviter refertur: non tamen
absque optima ratione ante oculos nobis statui-
tur quasi viua pictura gratiæ Dei, quæ fœdus
cum Abrahã percussum probauit ratum firmumque
esse. Abrahæ dictum fuerat, Semini tuo dabo
terram hanc: tempus quoque donationi præfixum
fuerat. Hic viua fidei à Deo præstitæ effigies non
secus occurrit, quàm si nos Deus in rem præsen-
tem adduceret. Octogenarius erat Iosue quum
terram ingressus est. In sene qui potuit tantum
esse vigoris, vt tot bellis gerendis & perferendis
militiæ oneribus sufficeret, nisi cœlesti virtute
suffultus humanum modum superasset? Conti-
nuus autem vincendi renor, prosperitas in quos-
libet euentus, non dubia nec varia in expugnan-
dis vrbibus facilitas: expeditionum celeritas, &
inflexibilis constantia, nonne clara manus Dei
fuerunt documenta, perinde acsi è cælo apparuissent.

page.notes: Handwritten marginalia at top right ("3 1 Reg..."), a stray mark near the head, and the signature "N.iiii." at the foot were not transcribed as printed text. The marginal reference "18" beside "non" is a note fragment; the Genesis references are transcribed together. Some letters in the scan are faint, notably "Iosue" and "renor", which may be misprinted or misread.
